metadata.name: DisputeDocumentsManagement
metadata.description: Use this API to Add/Download/View Documents to/from Case ID.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CaseID
request_fields.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Used for performing various operations when respective flag values defined below are passed. Valid Values: 1, 2 and 3. Example: 1 = Upload, 2 = Download and 3 = View Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: DocumentType
request_fields.description: Document Type Valid Values: 1, 2, etc. Example : 1= Cardholder Dispute Form, 2 = Merchant Communication Letter/email Please refer appendix Section : Document Type Condition: If the value in ‘DecisionFlag’ field is given as 1, then this field should become Mandatory. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: MIMEType
request_fields.description: MIME type Example :.pdf,.png,.jpg, .jpeg Condition: If the value in ‘DecisionFlag’ field is given as 1, then this field should become Mandatory.

request_fields.name: DocImage
request_fields.description: Document image in bytes Condition: If the value in ‘DecisionFlag’ field is given as 1, then this field should become Mandatory.

request_fields.name: DocumentName
request_fields.description: Name of the document. Condition: If the value in ‘DecisionFlag’ field is given as 1, then this field should become Mandatory. Allowable Values: 60

request_fields.name: DocumentUniqueID
request_fields.description: System generated unique Document ID. Example: 1,2,3 etc Condition: If the value in ‘DecisionFlag’ field is given as 2, then this field should become Mandatory.

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: DocumentType
children.description: Document Type Valid Values: 1, 2, etc. Example : 1= Cardholder Dispute Form, 2 = Merchant Communication Letter/email Please refer appendix Section : Document Type

children.name: DocumentUniqueID
children.description: System generated unique Document ID. Example: 1,2,3 etc.

children.name: DocumentType
children.description: Document Type Valid Values: 1, 2, etc. Example : 1= Cardholder Dispute Form, 2 = Merchant Communication Letter/email Please refer appendix Section : Document Type

children.name: DocumentUniqueID
children.description: System generated unique Document ID. Example: 1,2,3 etc.

children.name: DocumentUploadedBy
children.description: Id of User who last updated document. Valid values : a-z, 0-9 Example : headofficer

children.name: DocumentUploadedDate
children.description: Document Uploaded Date. Format: yyyy-mm-dd Example:2017-09-26

children.name: DocumentStatus
children.description: Shows the document status. Example: Active/Archived
